title: One-Slide Calibration of Pathology Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.08944v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scanner variation changes how pathology foundation models represent the same tissue. We introduce SlideRuler, which uses other regions within a slide as internal controls to predict a query region's scanner-induced shift. A transfer map learned from paired rescans enables calibration from a single scan at inference while keeping the foundation model fixed. Across two encoders and five SCORPION scanners, learned transfer reduces mean target-to-source embedding distance by 16.3-38.5% relative to raw embeddings. Replacing controls with unrelated same-scanner regions reveals a positive same-slide contribution in all four evaluation settings, including scanner holdout. A source-anchored variant reduces source-feature displacement by 47.7-83.6% relative to learned transfer while retaining most of its alignment gain. By drawing calibration information from the slide itself, SlideRuler offers a path toward more consistent use of frozen

translated_title: 病理基础模型的单切片校准
translated_abstract: 扫描仪的差异会改变病理基础模型对同一组织的表征方式。我们提出SlideRuler，它利用同一切片内的其他区域作为内部对照，来预测查询区域因扫描仪引起的偏移。通过配对重复扫描学习到的转移映射，使模型在推理时仅凭单次扫描即可完成校准，同时保持基础模型冻结不变。在两个编码器和五个SCORPION扫描仪上的实验表明，学习到的转移映射相对于原始嵌入将平均目标到源的嵌入距离降低了16.3-38.5%。用同扫描仪的不相关区域替换对照区域后，在包括扫描仪保留测试在内的全部四种评估设置中均显示出同切片对照的积极贡献。一种源锚定变体相对于学习转移映射将源特征位移降低了47.7-83.6%，同时保留了大部分对齐增益。通过从切片本身提取校准信息，SlideRuler为更一致地使用冻结的病理基础模型提供了一条可行路径。
tldr: SlideRuler利用同一切片内的其他区域作为内部对照，通过配对重扫学习转移映射，实现仅凭单次扫描即可校准病理基础模型的扫描仪偏移，且无需修改冻结的基础模型。
en_tdlr: SlideRuler uses other regions within a slide as internal controls to learn a transfer map that calibrates scanner-induced embedding shifts in pathology foundation models from a single scan, keeping the foundation model frozen.
